summary: Steep narrow lane beside a treed strip; no room to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane, kerb to trees and power poles

best_section.where: Top of Newcomen Street, west side by the treed strip

drivers.seclusion: Treed strip on own side; nearest houses 17-22 m across the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with trees and a powerline strip at the edge; no pull-off seen.
drivers.convention: Residents' cars park a little further up; no overnight stays seen.

flags: Steep: about 5% at best, up to 16% max
Witton Creek 42 m away, low-lying at the bottom
Homes within 25 m across the lane
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the stretch, especially from the east.
